description: Unknown delivery person calmly says the delivery OTP went to the registered number and to show it at the gate. Mentions an OTP but does not ask for it: no tactic hits, tier 0.

events.text: Hello sir, I am from the courier company and I am at your gate with the parcel, please come down
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Your delivery OTP has been sent to the number you registered, just show it to me at the gate, no hurry sir
events.speaker: caller
